# IA Code Studio (https://ia-codestudio.com)

> IA Code Studio is a free-to-start bilingual (English & French) browser-based AI Web App Builder, Code IDE, 3D WebGL Studio, and offline Developer Tools platform. Built around **IA Architecte Studio Pro** and **IA Architecte Studio Ultra v2.0**, it lets developers, designers, and creators generate clean HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, and Three.js code directly in the browser with zero setup.

## Flagship AI Coding Workspaces
- [IA Code Studio Home (EN)](https://ia-codestudio.com/) | [Version Française](https://ia-codestudio.com/fr/): Interactive AI prompt launcher, flagship IDE overview, 10 ready-to-export starter apps (1 free ZIP/day), and transparent pricing ($0 Free / $10/mo Pro).
- [IA Architecte Studio Pro (Flagship IDE)](https://ia-codestudio.com/ia-architecte-app/): Monaco-based AI Web IDE generating complete HTML, CSS, and JavaScript web apps from text prompts with live split preview, API design, security audits, and 1-click export.
- [IA Architecte Studio Pro Overview](https://ia-codestudio.com/ia-architecte-studio-pro/): Detailed feature breakdown, use cases, pricing, and FAQ for the flagship AI Web IDE.
- [IA Architecte Studio Ultra v2.0](https://ia-codestudio.com/ia-architecte-studio-ultra/): Multi-screen companion AI workbench with 28+ functional app templates, visual CSS/database inspector, 3D/AR spatial previews, and DevOps packager.

## 3D & WebGL Visual Studios Hub
- [All 3D & WebGL Visual Studios](https://ia-codestudio.com/3d-studios/) | [Français](https://ia-codestudio.com/fr/3d-studios/):
  - [3D Creative Studio v2.0](https://ia-codestudio.com/3d-creative-studio/): 72+ customizable interactive 3D UI components (buttons, holographic cards, Bento grids, 3D globes) with HTML, React JSX, and Vue 3 exports.
  - [3D Liquid Chrome & Neon Studio](https://ia-codestudio.com/3d-liquid-chrome-studio/): 18 procedural 4D metallic shader scenes (Cyber-Mecha, Tourbillon Watch, Hypercar, Stargate) with 3MF, GLB, and 4K UHD export.
  - [Studio 3D/4D Pro](https://ia-codestudio.com/studio-3d-4d-pro/): 2D SVG/DXF vector-to-3D extruder, STL/GLB/OBJ importer, and standalone Three.js exporter.
  - [HyperStudio 3D/4D Engine](https://ia-codestudio.com/hyperstudio-3d-4d/): Real-time 3D/4D HTML code engine, WebAR export, audio FFT visuals, and cosmic flight simulator.
  - [Quantum 3D HUD Builder](https://ia-codestudio.com/hologram-hud-builder/): Sci-fi holographic HUDs, tactical radars, GLSL Fresnel presets, and OBS overlays.
  - [Cyber Creative Studio](https://ia-codestudio.com/cyber-creative-studio/): 3D animated video intros with talking AI robot hosts and synthwave beat maker.

## Free Offline Developer Tools (100% Client-Side, Zero Upload)
- [Free Developer Tools & Sandbox Hub](https://ia-codestudio.com/free-tools/):
  - [OmniConvert Pro 2.0](https://ia-codestudio.com/free-tools/omni-convert/): Offline JSON, XML, YAML, Base64, QR code, and CSS gradient developer workstation.
  - [Live HTML/CSS/JS Sandbox v2.0](https://ia-codestudio.com/free-tools/playground/): CodeMirror split-screen playground with console and shareable `#code=` URLs.
  - [CSS Mesh Gradient & Shadow Lab](https://ia-codestudio.com/free-tools/converters/css-mesh-lab/)
  - [CSS Grid & Bento Layout Builder](https://ia-codestudio.com/free-tools/converters/grid-bento-builder/)
